newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Lisbon bourse sees growth in turnover in '97.
newsitem.headline: Lisbon bourse sees growth in turnover in '97.

text.p: Turnover on Lisbon bourse will increase in 1997 mainly due to the expected part-privatisation of electricity company EDP-Electricidade de Portugal, the bourse's managing director said.
"This year will be good for the capital market, both in terms of volume and sustained growth, with the stable macroeconomic conditions providing support," Jose Carlos Pestana Teixeira told Reuters.
"The privatisation of EDP is the main event for us this year," he added.
Some 25 percent of EDP is due to be privatised in the first half of 1997.
Pestana Teixeira said the bourse hoped to attract more small and medium sized companies to seek listings.
